licence.quantity_name: error of the corrected band positions of the seed-mean correction
caveats: CH-oop on hold-out (a) rests on 5 of the hold-out's 8 molecules (the others have no such band): the 95 % interval of a bootstrap over molecules is 0.93–3.2 cm⁻¹ and crosses the line (96 % of the resamples lie under it)
other on hold-out (a) rests on 8 molecules: the 95 % interval of a bootstrap over molecules is 1.45–3.19 cm⁻¹ and crosses the line (93 % of the resamples lie under it)
licence.rule: decision 65 (29 Oct 2026, amended 16 Nov 2026): a mode family is licensed where the error of what the product delivers — the error of the corrected band positions of the seed-mean correction: the carried ΔH network's seeds' mean ΔH added to the B3LYP Hessian and diagonalised, each corrected band paired to its ωB97X band by mode overlap and counted in the family of its B3LYP partner — is within 3 cm⁻¹ (decision 53) on both hold-outs, at the DFT-proxy level; until the amendment the licence was read on the first-order diagonal error averaged over the seeds, which the records keep under its own name; it replaces the layer-B rule of 25 Sep 2026; and since pipeline 0.15 a band's licence follows its own measured spread (m08/own_spread.py, aromir's rule): the networks correct the same molecule given in other ways — 8 random rotations, the mirror image and a rotated mirror image, 4 random listings of the atoms put into the canonical order and swaps of atoms the bond graph cannot tell apart (all of them up to 12; of more, 12 symmetries of the heavy-atom skeleton and 6 exchanges of hydrogens), drawn with the seed 7 — each band is paired with itself by its motion, and it is licensed only when its position lay no more than 3 cm⁻¹ from the printed one in every presentation tried: the distance from the printed presentation, not the range between presentations, and a sample, not a bound; where that cannot be measured, no band is licensed; the corrected positions are printed either way. It replaces the rule by a molecule's group of 19 Nov 2026 (TASKS 288), whose measurement — the release's invariance record, <stem>_invariance.json beside the release networks — describes the network and decides no licence
licence.rule_source: README.md, decision 65 as amended on 16 Nov 2026
licence.statement: licensed at the DFT proxy: ring-ip (1.17 / 1.22), CH-stretch (0.8 / 1.67), CH-oop (1.86 / 1.26), other (2.38 / 2.1); not licensed: none — error of the corrected band positions of the seed-mean correction on hold-outs (a) / (b) in cm⁻¹ against 3 (decision 65 as amended on 16 Nov 2026); CH-oop on hold-out (a) rests on 5 of the hold-out's 8 molecules (the others have no such band): the 95 % interval of a bootstrap over molecules is 0.93–3.2 cm⁻¹ and crosses the line (96 % of the resamples lie under it); other on hold-out (a) rests on 8 molecules: the 95 % interval of a bootstrap over molecules is 1.45–3.19 cm⁻¹ and crosses the line (93 % of the resamples lie under it); the first-order diagonal error of each seed's correction, averaged over the seeds, which the licence read until then: ring-ip (1.55 / 1.64), CH-stretch (1.15 / 2.02), CH-oop (2.22 / 1.72), other (2.91 / 3.68); no coupled-cluster licence
